ICT Teacher
Waad Education
Jeddah
Full-time

Full job description
Key Responsibilities

Plan, prepare, and deliver instructional lessons that facilitate active learning and meet curriculum standards.
Evaluate and document students' academic and personal development through tests, assignments, and observations.
Foster a safe, inclusive, and supportive classroom atmosphere that encourages student participation and collaboration.
Address diverse learning needs by offering tailored guidance, extra help, or resources to ensure all students succeed.
Collaborate with parents, colleagues, and administrators to share progress, address concerns, and support students' overall development.

Requirements

Completed Bachelor's degree.
Proven teaching qualifications (Bachelor / Masters) .
3+ years of experience .
Proficiency in the subject matter.
Proficiency in key teaching skills.
Proficiency in standards of child protection and safeguarding.


Benefits

A reputable school with a strong record of academic excellence

Supportive and collaborative work environment

Ongoing professional development opportunities

Competitive benefits, including health insurance, annual flight tickets, and tuition discounts for staff children
